settings.pipelines.stageRequiredHint: A deal can't move into this stage until these are filled. Fields required by earlier stages stay required here automatically (shown locked).
settings.pipelines.subtitle: Manage your CRM pipelines and their stages. Drag to reorder; changes apply everywhere immediately.
settings.pipelines.wonDialogDescription: Deals in “{name}” can't be marked as won until every field selected here is filled.
settings.pipelines.wonDialogTitle: Required fields to mark as won
settings.stub.caption: This settings section isn't available yet.
settings.teams.cardDescription: Create teams and assign members. Each member belongs to one team; adding them to another moves them.
settings.teams.deleteNoMembers: The team will be removed from the pickers. This cannot be undone.
settings.teams.deleteWithMembers#one: Its {count} member will be left unassigned. This cannot be undone.
settings.teams.deleteWithMembers#other: Its {count} members will be left unassigned. This cannot be undone.
settings.teams.footnote: Assigning a member to a team moves them off their previous team. Deleting a team leaves its members unassigned; history is untouched.
settings.teams.subtitle: Group members into teams for ownership.
settings.teams.title: Teams
settings.webhooks.auth.description: This key belongs to this workspace only: it's how a request is matched to your workspace, and anything without it is rejected. Send it with every request as an {header} header, and keep it private. Regenerate it if it leaks.
settings.webhooks.auth.title: Your workspace key
settings.webhooks.create.fields: {pipeline} accepts a name or id. Omit {stage} to drop into the pipeline's first stage. {externalId} makes retries safe: the same id never creates a duplicate deal.
settings.webhooks.create.summary: Turn an inbound lead into a new deal. Creates and links a person and organization when provided.
settings.webhooks.create.title: Create a deal
settings.webhooks.loadFailed: Couldn't load the webhook settings. Admins only.
settings.webhooks.regenerateConfirm: Regenerate the webhook secret? The old secret stops working immediately; you'll need to update it in n8n.
settings.webhooks.update.fields: Target the deal by its numeric {dealId} (returned when the deal is created). A {stage} change resets the deal's aging clock, just like editing it in the app.
settings.webhooks.update.summary: Patch an existing deal: move its stage, change its value, add a comment. Only the fields you send are changed.
settings.webhooks.update.title: Update a deal
settings.workspace.logoDescription: Shown at the top of the sidebar for everyone in this workspace, in place of the default mark.
settings.workspace.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG. A square image works best; it's resized to 256 px.
settings.workspace.logoUnreadable: That file couldn't be read as an image.
settings.workspace.title: Workspace
settings.workspace.subtitle: Settings that apply to everyone in this workspace.
settings.workspace.nameDescription: Shown to every member at the top of the sidebar.
settings.slack.title: Slack
settings.slack.description: Connect your Slack workspace for team notifications and the "Send Slack message" automation action. Secrets are stored securely and never shown again.
settings.slack.botTokenHint: An xoxb- token from your Slack app. Needed to post to a named channel and to send DMs.
settings.slack.webhookUrlHint: Optional. Posts to one fixed channel, used only when there is no bot token.
settings.slack.announceChannelHint: Where channel messages go when an automation names no channel.
settings.slack.keepCurrent: Leave blank to keep the current value
settings.slack.clearConfirm: Disconnect Slack? The bot token, webhook URL and announcements channel are all cleared, and Slack messages stop until you connect again.
table.noMatches: No results match the current filters.

activity.outcome.responseRequired: Write down what they replied to log it as replied
activity.outcome.responseOrSubjectRequir: Write what they replied, in the subject or here, to log it as replied
activity.outcome.completeHint: Replied needs their response. No reply closes this attempt and opens a copy to reschedule.
activity.bulk.contactSkipped: Calls, meetings, emails and WhatsApp aren't completed in bulk. Tick each one to record whether they replied.
activity.log.chooseReply: Choose Replied or No reply first
